method: Labelled contact sheets were opened with view_image; key crawl, damage/smoke, cab, tyre-ground and handover originals were also opened full-size. This ledger describes reviewed panels, not exhaustive pixel/camera coverage. Paused streaming pilots are excluded. Gear rows rely only on the listed macro image, not every unreviewed extra inspection frame.
